hints.title: Fixed Window Analysis
hints.text: Every valid candidate is a contiguous subarray of fixed length k.

hints.title: Tracking Distinct Elements
hints.text: Maintain a frequency counter of elements currently inside the window of size k, along with their running sum.

hints.title: Sliding Window Update
hints.text: Slide the window by adding the incoming element and subtracting the outgoing element. Whenever distinct keys count >= m, update the max sum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass sliding window with hash map size at most k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing distinct counts and sums for every k-length subarray takes O(n * k), which exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) auxiliary hash map to track counts of distinct numbers in the active window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement fixed-size sliding window with efficient distinct count tracking.
